correctness.rationale: Specialization of Schäfer–Anandkumar defining exact CGD formula to unconstrained zero-sum f=x^TCy, g=−f yields x+=(I+η²CC^T)^−1(x−ηCy), y+=(I+η²C^TC)^−1(y+ηC^Tx), every η>0. SVD gives on each σ>0 singular plane 1/(1+q²)[[1,−q],[q,1]] with q=ησ, singular norm factor (1+q²)^−1/2 and rotation arctan q. Orthogonal projections onto ker C^T and ker C are invariant; all positive singular modes vanish exponentially so iterates converge to the Euclidean projection onto Nash set for arbitrary rectangular C. Exact distance²=sum_j(a_j²+b_j²)/(1+η²σ_j²)^k; sharp worst-mode at smallest nonzero σ. C=0 is identity; approximate inner solves excluded.
